en: Sepia-toned rural scene showing a small village. In the foreground, a shallow stream or pond is bordered by trees, with a woman and several cows or oxen standing in the water. Further back, another person leads livestock, and a horse-drawn cart is visible on a dirt road. Modest single-story houses with pitched, shingled or thatched roofs line the background, partially obscured by trees and wooden fences. The overall style suggests an early-20th‑century European countryside photograph.
